test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

Every members of the alumni group (1)/ who attended the annual meet (2)/ shared their experiences with great enthusiasm (3)/ over a formal dinner. (4)

options.text: Every members of the alumni group (1)
shared their experiences with great enthusiasm (3)

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the phrase "**Every members**" in part 1 of the sentence.
 
• The word "**Every**" should be followed by a singular noun, not a plural one.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**Every member**," ensuring agreement between the determiner and the noun.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Every member of the alumni group who attended the annual meet shared their experiences with great enthusiasm over a formal dinner."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 2: "who attended the annual meet"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 3: "shared their experiences with great enthusiasm"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4: "over a formal dinner"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
